HENU Platform System Architecture

This document outlines the high-level architecture, component topology, trust boundaries, and end-to-end data pipelines for the HENU Operating System application ecosystem.

---

1. Component Topology #

The platform comprises six repositories operating as a coordinated, loosely-coupled distributed system:

flowchart TD subgraph Development ["Product Repositories"] PA["henu-pa"] AI["henu-ai"] IDE["henu-ide"] Actions["henu-common-actions (Reusable CI/CD)"] PA -.-> Actions AI -.-> Actions IDE -.-> Actions end

subgraph GitHub ["GitHub Infrastructure"] GH_Releases["GitHub Releases (Binaries + SHA256SUMS)"] GH_Webhook["GitHub App Webhooks"] Actions --> GH_Releases Actions --> GH_Webhook end

subgraph PlatformAPI ["HENU Platform API (NestJS + PostgreSQL)"] API_Webhook["Webhook Ingress (HMAC Verification)"] API_Release["Release Engine (Streaming SHA-256)"] API_Auth["Auth & RBAC (Argon2id + JWT + MFA)"] API_Catalogue["Catalogue Revision Manager"] API_SSE["Server-Sent Events (SSE)"] DB[("PostgreSQL 16")]

GH_Webhook --> API_Webhook API_Webhook --> API_Release API_Release --> DB API_Auth --> DB API_Catalogue --> DB API_Catalogue --> API_SSE end

subgraph Admin ["HENU Admin Panel (Next.js 14)"] Admin_UI["Web Dashboard (React 18 / Tailwind)"] Admin_UI <--> API_Auth Admin_UI <--> API_Release Admin_UI <--> API_Catalogue end

subgraph Catalog ["Public Catalogue Repository"] Catalog_Schema["henu-app-catalog (Draft 2020-12)"] API_Catalogue --> Catalog_Schema end

subgraph Client ["End-User Desktop"] HUB["HENU HUB (Tauri 2 + React + Rust + SQLite)"] API_SSE -. Live Updates .-> HUB HUB -- "ETag Fetch /hub/catalogue" --> API_Catalogue HUB -- "Download Package" --> GH_Releases HUB -- "SHA-256 & Silent Install" --> OS_Native["Host OS (Win / Mac / Linux)"] end

2. Repository Responsibilities #

RepositoryTech StackRole & Scope
[henu-platform-api](https://github.com/henu-os/henu-platform-api)NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, RedisSource of truth backend: authentication, RBAC, application inventory, GitHub App integration, release validation state machine, catalogue revision publishing, and live SSE event broadcasts.
[henu-addplo](https://github.com/henu-os/henu-addplo)Next.js 14, React 18, Tailwind CSS, TypeScriptSecure administrative interface: app registration, repository connections, release approvals, rollback controls, audit log viewer, and user management.
[henu-hub](https://github.com/henu-os/henu-hub)Tauri 2, React 18, TypeScript, Rust, SQLiteCross-platform client application manager: dynamic catalogue discovery, package downloading, cryptographic integrity verification, running-app protection, and lifecycle orchestration.
[henu-app-catalog](https://github.com/henu-os/henu-app-catalog)JSON Schema 2020-12, TypeScriptPublic manifest specification: immutable catalogue revisions, manifest hashing, content integrity validation, and rollbacks.
[henu-common-actions](https://github.com/henu-os/henu-common-actions)GitHub Actions, Node.js, ShellCentralized CI/CD: reusable build workflows for Windows, macOS, and Linux, SHA-256 generation, SLSA provenance attestations, and webhook notifications.
[henu-hub-docs](https://github.com/henu-os/henu-hub-docs)Markdown, MermaidCentral technical, architectural, operational, and deployment reference across all ecosystem components.
---

3. End-to-End Data Pipeline #

Release Authoring & Ingestion #

  1. Packaging: Independent product repositories build binaries via henu-common-actions.
  2. Attestation & Hashing: All binaries receive cryptographic SHA-256 digests and SLSA build attestations before publication to GitHub Releases.
  3. Webhook Ingestion: GitHub publishes a release webhook event signed with HMAC-SHA256.
  4. Verification: henu-platform-api validates the signature, streams asset bytes to verify SHA-256 checksums, and records the release in PENDING_APPROVAL status.
  5. Approval: Release Managers approve the release in henu-addplo.

Catalogue Publication & Client Synchronization #

  1. Revision Publication: The Admin publishes a new immutable catalogue revision with content hashes.
  2. SSE Broadcast: henu-platform-api broadcasts a catalogue:updated event to connected clients.
  3. ETag Fetch: henu-hub requests /hub/catalogue with If-None-Match. If unmodified, 304 is returned; otherwise, the new manifest is downloaded and saved to the local SQLite database.
  4. Zero-Rebuild Discovery: New applications and channels appear immediately in HENU HUB without recompiling or redeploying the launcher binary.

---

4. Trust Boundaries & Security Model #

  • Private Admin vs. Public Catalogue: Private administration data, API keys, and admin tokens remain exclusively within henu-platform-api behind Argon2id + TOTP MFA authentication.
  • Client Zero-Trust: henu-hub never executes arbitrary remote commands; all actions flow through strictly typed, sandboxed OS platform adapters.
  • Integrity Validation: Packages must match their declared SHA-256 digest before native execution is permitted.
